report.metadata: Pending labels belong to the mechanical report. Companions add reviewed interpretation without changing its measurements or collection source references.

quality_scope.limit: Known repeated questions; no fresh accuracy evidence.

verification.scope: Completed preparation checks on the stated base working tree with cached assets; no fresh-install or merged-checkout claim.

declared_conditions.desktop: macOS, managed security and controlling editor active; no competing intentional model, build or test jobs during measured collection.
declared_conditions.power: AC power and open lid; no persistent power-setting changes.
declared_conditions.cache: Fresh server processes with cached model/runtime assets. Integrity reads warm filesystem caches; no cold-cache claim.
declared_conditions.failure_policy: All planned observations retained; no replaced observations or selective retries.

sleep_protection.scope: One outer clock guard and bounded AC-only system-sleep assertion span readiness and all three stages; each stage retains its original guard and rests.
sleep_protection.limits: Boundary assertion observations and finite clock tolerances do not prove continuous OS conditions or detect every short interruption.

review_provenance.basis: Shared mechanical validators plus independent integer-clock metrics, group arithmetic and source-backed answer review.
review_provenance.limits: Project contributors, not human or external validation. Runtime/model authentication is collector-recorded; no new build or loaded-library tracing claim.

service_restoration.scope: No services or persistent settings were changed for collection. Collection-owned processes and sleep assertions were released and verified.

host_findings.scope: Boundary readings do not establish CPU isolation or constant temperatures.

interpretation.scope: Descriptive CPU application results on one Mac.
limits: Buffered output is not model time to first token, which remains unobserved.
Separate stage medians do not isolate retrieval cost or establish an application backend speedup.
Worker and native-child RSS values are separate lifetime peaks and must not be added.
